title: 订单数
question: 过去一周每天的订单数
sql:
SELECT
  o.order_date AS date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders AS o
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-24' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY
  o.order_date
ORDER BY
  date
LIMIT 1000
